_comment: THE SHIPPED MODEL, IN TRACKED FORM. predict.py contains no literal blend weights: they
travel inside bundle.json in the 57 MB checkpoint, which is not in git. Without this file a
clone of this repo carries no record anywhere of the mixture that produced the reported
numbers. Read from the graded checkpoint, not transcribed from any document.
This file is DOCUMENTATION. predict.py reads its weights from the checkpoint, never from
here, so editing this changes nothing at inference — it only makes the record wrong.

rung_1.fit: convex simplex fit on blk < 224, scored on blk >= 224, pooled over the three gapped CV windows; every member carrying the A9 cross-series aggregates

rung_2._comment: The fallback when the fine-tuned Chronos-2 cannot be fetched. ITS OWN measured weights, not rung 1's re-spread over two members.

rung_3._comment: Rung 2's members and weights with the cascade channel blanked to its stored per-series median and *_missing = 1. Chosen inside attach_cascade_channels.

rung_4._comment: Tree alone, when the neural bag produces nothing.

desmoothing.applied: pred' = unit_mean + gamma * (pred - unit_mean), every rung
desmoothing._comment: Blending shrinks variance; gamma expands it back. 1.04 rather than our own frame's optimum of 1.06 — see the block that applies it in predict.py.

chronos_full_ft.what: amazon/chronos-2, fully fine-tuned on this dataset
chronos_full_ft.weights: hosted on Hugging Face, fetched at inference

cascade_bag.what: 5-seed bag of the SWA TFT, trained on a zero-shot Chronos-2 forecast as a known-future covariate

zero_shot_covariate.used_for: the chronos2_forecast known-future channel the cascade bag conditions on

caveat: Every CV number here is pooled FAR-regime WAPE over the blk >= 224 rows of the scored block -- its final 112 hours -- across three gapped windows (cutoffs 3648 / 3312 / 2976): 96 series x 112 hours x 3 = 32,256 rows, self-scored against labels carved from the public 4320 hours. Blend weights are fitted on blk < 224, so this is the held-out half. The public leaderboard scores the NEAR block (gap 0) and is not comparable; see docs/results.md.
